import sys
input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
degrees = []
xors = []
index = 1
for i in range(n):
    degree = int(input[index])
    xor_sum = int(input[index + 1])
    degrees.append(degree)
    xors.append(xor_sum)
    index += 2
edges = []
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1, n):
        if degrees[i] > 0 and degrees[j] > 0 and (xors[i] & (1 << j)) != 0 and (xors[j] & (1 << i)) != 0:
            edges.append((i, j))
            degrees[i] -= 1
            degrees[j] -= 1
print(len(edges))
for edge in edges:
    print(edge[0], edge[1])
